source: Open Images official TEST split, V5 boxes/human labels and 2018_04 image metadata.
selection: All eligible football-positive images plus three deterministic verified Ball(Object)-negative images per positive. Exclude any positive ball label from the negative pool.
overlap_exclusion: Exclude Flickr photo IDs in all COCO 2017 train and validation image records; reject unknown photo identities. This does not certify absence from every backbone pretraining dataset.
qualification: Require explicit per-image CC BY 2.0, known zero rotation and author identity. Exclude ball group/depiction images and ambiguous overlapping parent/subclass boxes. Merge exact identical boxes only. Also exclude prior pilot authors/photos and exact JPEG duplicates against the pilot or within this cohort before inference.
split: All eligible records are external_test; exclude every prior pilot author and photo identity.
inference: No training or threshold tuning. YOLO11m keeps its existing 1920 input protocol; RF-DETR uses its published processor size. Both float32, confidence >=0.05, at most 300 detections; retain only sports ball by class name.
selection_metric: No selection on this corpus; validate the previously frozen development-selected tiny-ball method and frozen controls once.
